ops.title: Helper agents emit LimitLoadToSessionType — launchctl bootstrap fails EIO 5; helper delivery wedged fleet-wide
ops.description:
Root cause CONFIRMED empirically on two machines (2026-07-26, fleet-stabilization task fc39f885): `launchctl bootstrap` deterministically returns `Bootstrap failed: 5: Input/output error` for daemonkit-emitted helper plists carrying `LimitLoadToSessionType`; removing that single key makes bootstrap succeed first-try. daemonkit's controller treats exit 5 as transient "in flux" (controller.go:551-604, 6 retries with backoff), so a deterministic refusal burns the retry loop and fails install — which gates brew postinstall app delivery (captain-hook) and the synckit helper cutover.

Observation matrix (all launchd-verified):

| plist | key | Program kind | bootstrap context | result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| com.yasyf.captain-hook.host.v1 (local) | Aqua | plain exe (bundle Contents/Helpers) | Aqua session | loads fine |
| com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper (local) | Aqua | GUI .app binary | Aqua session, manager=Aqua (mismatch ruled out) | EIO ×3 installs + raw repro; key removal → exit 0, helper runs (pid 64693) |
| com.github.yasyf.synckit.helper.reposync (yasyf-home) | Background | plain CLI exe (Caskroom) | SSH → gui domain, manager=Background | EIO via install + raw repro on a FRESH label; key removal → exit 0, pid 87328, rpc.sock live, handshakes green |
| synckit serve/reconcile (both machines) | none | staged plain exe | various | loads fine |

So the key is fatal in at least two distinct configurations (.app Program with matching session type; Background value from an SSH context) and known-safe in exactly one (Aqua + plain exe + Aqua session). Quarantine ruled out (removed on home, no change); session-type MISMATCH ruled out (local failure has desired==current==Aqua); per-label launchd DB wedge ruled out (home's label was virgin).

Fix direction: stop emitting LimitLoadToSessionType for helper agents in the serviceAgents() path — consider remapping the manifest helper `session_type: Background` intent to ProcessType Background (reconcile's proven pattern). Related, separate: 74be91d7 (helper Program bakes versioned Caskroom paths — staging bypass), 955ce63c (persistent EIO misclassified as in-flux by the retry loop).

INTERIM FLEET STATE — fragile: both machines now run key-stripped helper plists (evidence copies: local /tmp/capt-hook.helper.plist.bak, home /tmp/helper-reposync-original.plist). ANY plist regeneration (`synckitd install`, `brew reinstall captain-hook`, `capt-hook helper install`) re-emits the key and re-wedges. captain-hook 12.20.10 delivery and the yasyf-box helper cutover are gated on this fix; a targeted v0.20.7 freeze exception is with the user.

ops.text: Helper-derived Agent plists carry no LimitLoadToSessionType (or only a combination proven bootstrappable from every install context, including SSH)
Regression test covers the helper plist emission
synckitd install / capt-hook helper install complete without bootstrap EIO on a machine that previously failed (yasyf-home or local)
